description: Use this when the user wants printable lined paper or kindergarten writing paper as a vector PDF. Produces 1 to 20 pages with solid top and baseline guides, descender space and an optional dashed midline. Four body heights, Letter or A4, portrait or landscape. Does not produce cursive examples.

line_size.description: Capital-to-baseline body height in inches: 0.5, 0.625, 0.75 or 1.0. Example: 0.5. Default 0.5.

midline.description: Include the dashed guide halfway between top and baseline. Example: true. Default true.

orientation.description: Page direction: portrait or landscape. Example: portrait. Default portrait.

pages.description: Number of blank practice pages, whole number 1 to 20. Example: 2. Default 1.

paper.description: Paper: Letter or A4. Example: Letter. Default Letter.

title.description: Optional page title, up to 80 supported characters. Example: Letter practice.

name: generate_lined_paper
title: Generate lined paper
